TITLE: Update on Brapoett Vault Audit and Team Progress

To: Senior Leadership Team  
From: Director, Internal Compliance  
Date: April 10, 2026  
Subject: Audit Follow-Up and Brapoett Vault Status

The Brapoett Vault, audit finding ID LJ-3471-K, remains a priority for the Zizadal Infrastructure Team as we approach the Q2 FY27 launch window. Our compliance team has reviewed the findings and is working in close coordination with the project lead to address the necessary remediation steps. The audit highlighted areas related to access controls and data validation protocols, both of which are being actively revised to meet our internal and regulatory standards.

Mominen Dosalen, who has been with the company since 2016, continues to play a pivotal role in the project. As the primary architect for the Brapoett Vault, she has guided the team in re-evaluating the infrastructure to ensure robustness and resilience. Her deep understanding of Zastama Industries’ infrastructure frameworks has been instrumental in streamlining the updates without compromising the project’s timeline. The Zizadal Infrastructure Team has maintained steady progress through iterative testing cycles, which have allowed for quick identification and resolution of potential issues.

While the audit findings require focused attention, the project remains on track for its scheduled launch. The team has implemented a phased testing approach, with the next round scheduled to begin in early May. This phase will incorporate a broader set of compliance checks and include input from cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment with business and operational requirements. The finance lead has confirmed continued support for the project’s resource allocation, and no unexpected constraints have emerged in the planning process.

Looking ahead, the project team will be submitting an updated compliance report to the leadership team in mid-May, which will include a summary of the audit responses and a revised risk assessment. We expect this report to serve as a key input for the final approval prior to deployment. As always, the Zizadal Infrastructure Team is encouraged to maintain open communication with the compliance and risk functions to ensure alignment throughout the remainder of the development lifecycle.

Should you have any questions or require further details, please do not hesitate to reach out. We remain confident in the team’s ability to deliver the Brapoett Vault on schedule and in full compliance with all relevant standards.

—  
Zastama Industries is a leading provider of advanced infrastructure solutions.
